messages:
Arjun: Quick sync — we need to lock down who can see what in audit logs for tenants. Specifically: should "member" users be allowed to see admin-level events (RBAC changes, scoped-token creation) within their tenant? cc @Mel @Jamie
Mel: Short answer: no to admin-level. Members can see resource events (deploys, uploads, prompt/API usage) but not RBAC or KMS admin ops. Compliance + noise. :shield:
Jamie: Agreed. Suggest adding an explicit event field like "sensitivity": "admin|tenant|public" so UI and exports can filter deterministically. That also helps signed/export proofs.
Dana: Also: scoped tokens are tricky. Creation should be admin-only, but token usage events (api.request with token id) could be visible to members if the token was issued for a member-owned app. Service-account-issued scoped tokens are admin-only visibility.
Arjun: Good point. On KMS events — we currently emit kms.sign and kms.decrypt. For customer-facing exports do we redact key ids? full key ids may be sensitive.
Mel: Redact key material and full key ids. Return a key_alias or truncated id (e.g. last 4 chars) for debugging. Include a separate signed proof that maps truncated id -> full id for internal support only.
Jamie: Example event prototype I can put in the migration PR:
```json
{ "ts": 1717200001, "event": "token.create", "actor": "user:mel", "tenant": "t-123", "sensitivity": "admin", "redacted_fields": ["token_secret"] }
```
Use visibility/sensitivity for frontends and exports.
ops-bot: audit-export-service: export job 6732 queued by Jamie (tenant t-123) :package:
Dana: RBAC proposal: add explicit permission "audit:read". Roles with it: admin, security, audit-reader. audit-reader can view tenant-level events but not "admin" sensitivity ones. This lets SOC teams get read-only access without full admin perms.
Arjun: Can scoped tokens grant "audit:read"? If so, require issuer to be tenant-owned service-account and enforce short TTL + single-use for exports.
Mel: Yes, scoped tokens can be allowed the permission but only if issued with "issuer=service_account:tenant" and audited issuance. Deny cross-tenant bindings.
Jamie: I'll draft a schema migration: add fields: "visibility": "public|tenant|admin", "redacted_fields": [ ... ], and "actor_type" to help filtering. I will open a PR and include examples for export redaction and signed internal mapping.
Arjun: SGTM. Action items: Jamie -> PR schema + examples; Mel -> draft policy text for exports and KMS redaction; Dana -> update RBAC matrix and add audit:read role; I'll book a 15min hangout if any quick triage needed. :thumbsup:
Mel: Thanks — I'll also add a short note for support playbook on how to request internal key-id mapping (signed request + 2FA).
Jamie: will tag the PR with migration steps and a flag to backfill sensitivity for historical events.
Dana: I'll update the incident playbook with who to notify on accidental exposure of admin events.
Arjun: Great. Leaving this thread open for any other edge-cases.
